title: Mixed reaction
text: Mixed reaction. It’s a gamble buying any mattress without being able to test it out first, especially for a couple. I haven’t fully made my decision about it, but generally I find it okay and just working my way mentally to adjust sleeping on memory foam vs a traditional mattress. However, my husband feels that he doesn’t get the support he needs (too soft for him), and is not sleeping well. So, we will probably be hitting the mattress stores to find something that will work better for him. Just bear that in mind when looking into getting  any mattresses that comes in box, it may or may not workout for you individually or as a couple, and returning it (if allowed, am sure this varies by seller) maybe too much of a hassle to be worth attempting. Plan on being willing to make a set investment (an amount your comfortable with) where if works out great, and if not oh well I/we tried.
